decisions.reason: The single-tube air cooled condenser moved from a mention in 2023 to its own page in 2024, showing growing commitment to a product close to the core offer.
This condenser variant was also upgraded to a dedicated page in 2024, signaling active promotion within an established product line.
Liners for corroded tubes fit the firm's lifecycle service strategy and cost little to keep, though the site still only mentions them without dedicated promotion.
Customized air coolers are central to the firm's integrated-solution positioning, although the lack of a dedicated page suggests only moderate emphasis.
Tube end repair inserts support the repair and spare-parts business at low cost and match the move toward lifecycle services.
